section.title: Examples of Accessing the API
section.p: See Authenticate page to acquire a token.

sectiondiv.p: The following example shows how to use curl to Update only the status of an order.
The following example shows how to use Python to Update only the status of an order.
sectiondiv.codeblock: import requests import json headers = { "Accept": "application/json", "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "<auth-token>" } with open("request.json") as f: data = json.load(f) url = "https://" + SERVER_URL + "/api/v1/orders/{orderId}/status" resp = requests.put(url, headers=headers, data=data)
